subject: Bar not displayed when upper ylim is smaller then max y.

messages.author: 6ada7ec7a3d8505c
messages.subject: Bar not displayed when upper ylim is smaller then max y.
parts:
Hello,

 

I was plotting a geom_bar and encountered the following problem:

 

library(ggplot2)

data1 <- as.data.frame(seq(1:100))

ggplot(data=data1) + geom_bar(aes(x=1)) # Bar is shown

 

When the upper ylim < max y value the bar is not shown:

 

ggplot(data=data1) + geom_bar(aes(x=1)) + ylim(0,99)

 

Is this normal behaviour? Is there already a thread on this subject?

 

Greetings,

Jonas

messages.author: f4249b01b99d0091
messages.subject: Re: Bar not displayed when upper ylim is smaller then max y.
parts:
Hi Jonas,

Yes, this is expected behavior (and frankly yes, there are already
many threads on this subject).

Basically, using ylim like this limits the *scale*, which is
equivalent to plotting a subset of the original data. What you wanted
to do (I think) is put a limit on the coordinate system, i.e. zoom in
leaving data unchanged. For this use +coord_cartesian(ylim=c(0,99)).

Ben
